verdict.rationale: Feitian's own docs show the keys carry a PIV function managed through SK Manager. They cover configuring macOS PIV smart card logon and applying PIV for digital signatures, so certificate-based workstation sign-in and signing are documented at least on macOS. Coverage of the rest of the story is thin, and the docs are only one-line tutorial pointers. Missing for 10: Windows/Linux PIV smart card logon, VPN certificate authentication, code signing specifically, documentation that private keys are generated and kept non-exportable on the device, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key acts as a PIV smart card for certificate-based login — workstation sign-in, VPN, and code signing with keys that never leave the device
